scenes.summary: You enter Qingbo Stockade and see Liao the Scarless heavily injured. Just when you are doubting the Xiranite Gourd's effectiveness, Liao tells you how the device actually saved him. To play things safe, you decide to check the situation of the Blight outside Qingbo Stockade.

lines.text: Ugh... The friggin' Blight. It's everywhere... Hngh...
Argh... Thank goodness I brought... Ssss...
Fam, Darkmask is here! We're getting more of those precious gourds!
You're a lifesaver, Darkmask! If not for your gourd, I would've ended up as a corpse outside the Stockade.
I should've never doubted your gourd... Gotta apologize to you, Darkmask... HNGH! THE PAIN...
I'm good. Still alive... Darkmask?
Doesn't work? Says who...? Oh, Darkmask?
I should play it safe and check on the Blight outside Qingbo Stockade.

options: What's ... going on?
What just happened?
Are you alright?
Does that mean ... the Xiranite Gourd doesn't work?
It's okay, Fam...
I'm just glad you're okay.
Make sure you get some proper rest.

scenes.summary: You leave Qingbo Stockade and happen to run into Zuo Guyan. The watchguard is looking for a Stockader who saved his life. After a brief discussion, he hands you the formula for an upgraded version of the Xiranite Gourd.

lines.text: Oh? Endmin! Hah. I have patrol duties in these parts. Decided to pay a visit when I heard something happened at Qingbo Stockade.
Picked it up from "The Watchguard's Tale" — The book says that huge secrets are usually hidden in the most unassuming of places.
Say, Endmin, did our Stockaders start using the gourds?
Nice. As long as they're using the gourds.
Heheh, my patrols took me outside Qingbo Stockade...
Oh... Yeah, well. I should know better than to hide things from our Endmin.
It's nothing serious. I just want to look for someone... The person's a Stockader, but that's all I know.
The Aggeloi ambushed me during patrol duties several years ago. Fortunately, the Stockaders saved my life.
But the day was really dark and I didn't see any of them clearly. I wanted to give my thanks, but I have no idea who I should look for.
I finally found my chance this time! In "The Grateful Burdenbeast", if you can't find a goal, you just do everything.
I will help every Stockader and finally set my heart at ease.
Hahaha. Yeah, Endmin, please don't go around telling people about this.
I've never mentioned it to anyone.
Well, it's kinda obvious. I'm a watchguard. According to the guide, Stockaders don't like helping us at all.
And if my colleagues or friends learn that the Stockaders saved my skin, I'd be a laughingstock.
Imagine if Captain Mi Fu hears about this... Now that's a truly scary thought. Last thing I need if I really want that promotion fast.
Haiz. Got it right from "3000 Questions for Nabbing that Promo" I bought during patrol duty on Fangxing Avenue. You won't need it, Endmin.
Oh. It's not a joke, Endmin. They're super useful! I impressed the other watchguards and everyone wants to go on patrols with me.
And time's getting late. I'll get back to patrolling, Endmin. Don't let me keep you around.
Ah? Oh yeah, this patrol made me forget about the super important biz. Tianshi Yan Ning told me to give this to you.
This upgrade won't get you through the Blight Tide directly, but it performs way better than the previous version of the Xiranite Gourd.
Thank Talos you reminded me, Endmin. I'd taken this all the way back to Wuling otherwise.

options: Zuo Guyan?
What are you doing here?
Do the watchguards patrol areas near the Stockade?
I don't remember seeing you here before.
They did.
"Outside"? You're almost inside.
Looking for someone?
I thought it's about your promotion again.
So you're patrolling this area for your savior.
I'm very glad to hear that.
Never mentioned it? Why not?
Another guide of yours...?
Sounds like a guide that I should read.
Maybe you can try reading something else.
You really take these books super seriously...
So what are you doing here?
Any news about the Xiranite Gourd?
